# ONSHAPE BOILERPLATE — Full Logic & Capability Inventory for scadgen

*Generated 2026-10-17. Source: `~/references/onshape-fs-library.md` (731 KB FeatureScript Standard Library docs dump, captured 2026-10-17 from cad.onshape.com/FsDoc; re-fetch if lost). Companion: `~/cadjs/docs/ONSHAPE_MAP.md` (feature-tree REST protocol + OCC mapping). Complements, not replaces: this file is the **capability blueprint**; ONSHAPE_MAP is the **transport/data format**.*

Coverage: **217 modules** extracted → 8 Modeling, 16 Math, 38 Utilities, 54 feature modules + 101 enum pages under "Onshape features". **1,389 documented entries** inventory'd (55 `op*`, 124 `q*`, 45 `ev*`, 4 `f*`, 15 `sk*`, plus feature-module and support-module summaries; 90 entries carry no purpose line in the source — overloads/constants, flagged as such).

---

## 1. CORE LOGIC MODEL — the engine scadgen replicates

Onshape's entire product is one deterministic pipeline. Seven pillars, each with a direct cadjs design consequence:

| # | Onshape pillar | Mechanism (verified from FS stdlib docs) | scadgen/cadjs consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Context** | One `builtin` per Part Studio holding all bodies (solid/sheet/wire/point), their topology (faces/edges/vertices), variables, and feature error states. "Different contexts do not interact, but data may be transferred." Every feature/operation/evaluation function takes the context. | Single model DB per document — cadjs `useCadCore` scene state IS the context. One flat mutable store, not scattered meshes. |
| 2 | **Id** | Hierarchical string ids (`featureId + "opSuffix"`), unique per feature/subfeature/operation. `makeId`/`newId`; `unstableIdComponent` marks index-derived id parts as wildcards — ids are *content-addressed provenance*, not pointers. | cadjs operation tree nodes need stable hierarchical ids; VR selection handles must reference ids, never raw OCC pointers. |
| 3 | **Query** | "A query is a map that contains instructions for how to find entities… Queries in general do not contain a list of entities in any form. Rather, they contain criteria." Never pre-resolved: ops/evals take queries directly and resolve them against the context at call time. Two families: **state-based** ("all edges adjacent to a cylindrical face touching this point") and **historical** ("the edge generated by `extrude_1` from sketch vertex `v` of sketch `s`"). | THE key insight for VR sub-primitive UX: selection = saved *criteria*, not saved pointers. Geometry changes → queries re-resolve → downstream ops survive edits. cadjs must persist query-as-data (predicate JSON) in the feature tree. |
| 4 | **op\* builtins** | `geomOperations.fs` "contains wrappers around built-in Onshape operations and no actual logic" — the 55 `op*` functions are the ONLY geometry mutations; everything else in the 217-module library is deterministic pure logic layered on them. Multi-entity queries into single-entity op params take the first resolved entity. | cadjs' OCC op layer = our `op*` boundary. Port targets: keep the kernel surface this small; all power features are scripts on top. |
| 5 | **f\* / sk\* / feature modules** | `fCuboid` etc. create bodies in one call; `sk*` functions fill a `Sketch` object; each of the 54 feature modules exposes one entry function. All of them only ever mutate context via op*/sk*/sub-features. | The "grammar" for scadgen's AI co-pilot: every user intent compiles to a tree of these calls (see §3 inventory). |
| 6 | **defineFeature(rebuild fn)** | A feature = parameter schema + regeneration function re-executed on every rebuild. Context pins the stdlib version it was created at: "while regenerating a feature that has been 'held back' to an older version, the version reported by the context" is the old one — behavior is frozen per-document. | Parametric history = replayable function DAG. cadjs tree must store (featureType, parameters) per node and rebuild top-down; version-pin our op semantics for file-format stability. |
| 7 | **Quantity + variables** | `Quantity = {expression, units, value}` — dimensions are live formulas, not floats; a variables table is re-evaluated each rebuild. `variable`/`queryVariable` features expose them to the UI. | VR dimension input ("shrink-grow + relative scale") writes expressions into the tree; measure mode reads them back. Direct match to BTMParameter.Quantity in ONSHAPE_MAP §1. |

**The rebuild cycle (the whole product in one line):**
`edit parameter/variable → invalidate dependent features (DAG) → per feature: re-run regeneration fn { sk* fill sketch → q* select topology → ev* measure → op* mutate } → deterministic new context → tessellate for display (gltf/visual), keep BRep for truth.`

Onshape ships no separate "undo" model: history IS the feature tree, rollback = `featureStates` build markers (already decoded, ONSHAPE_MAP §1-2). cadjs `buildUndoSnapshot` + `apply*ToTree` functions are the embryonic version of exactly this — the ladder in §6 completes the correspondence.

## 3. FEATURE-CATEGORY MAP — all 54 feature modules

The 54 capitalized modules under "Onshape features" are the complete UI-feature universe; the 101 lowercase modules are their enum/vocabulary pages (mode toggles feeding `BTMParameter.Enum`, e.g. `chamfertype`, `sweeptwisttype`, `lofttopology`, `wraptype`…). Full per-module function inventory per §2 tables; grouped here:

| Category | Modules (functions count) | Essence |
|---|---|---|
| **Solid creation** | extrude(3) revolve(1) sweep(1) loft(1) boolean(1) enclose(1) cutlist(1) shell(1) thicken(1) | The 9 op-backed volume builders. loft+sweep carry Onshape twist/orientation enums (`sweeptwisttype`) cadjs must mirror. |
| **Edge blending** | fillet(2) chamfer(2) faceBlend(1) modifyFillet(2) | `fullRoundFillet` = opFullRoundFillet; conditional/partial blends via `modifyFillet`. |
| **Direct editing** | moveFace(2) deleteFace(2) replaceFace(1) extend(2) trimCurve/moveCurveBoundary(1) editCurve(5) offsetCurveOnFace(3) mutualTrim(1) splitpart(1) splitFace/splitByIsocline/splitBySelfShadow (via opSplit*) bodyDraft(2) draft(1) | Push/pull face, heal-void delete, split-and-keep — the VR "grab a face and move it" grammar, already 1:1 with our grip system. |
| **Surface modeling** | bsurf(3) fillSurface(1) ruledSurface(3) constrainedSurface(3) bridgingCurve(7) compositeCurve(1) fitSpline(2) isoparametricCurve(1) offsetSurface(1) faceIntersection(1) projectCurves(2) wrap(1) decal(1) | op* surface family: BoundarySurface/FillSurface/RuledSurface/CreateBSplineSurface/ConstrainedSurface/ExtractSurface/ProjectCurves/Wrap. NOTE: no "knit" module in this stdlib release — mutualTrim+extend+constrainedSurface is the knit-equivalent workflow. |
| **Patterns & transforms** | linearPattern(1) circularPattern(1) curvePattern(2) mirror(1) transformCopy(2) | All funnel to one builtin: `opPattern` (instances of a transform, optionally fusing copies) — `patternCommon`/`patternUtils` utilities hold the shared logic; feature patterns replay subfeatures. |
| **Holes & threads** | hole(2) holeTable(1) externalThread(2) (+ cosmeticThreadUtils) | `opHole` = single kernel op; hole/tap/counterbore profiles are enum-driven (`holeprofiletype`). |
| **Structural** | rib(1) gusset(2) endcap(1) frame(7) frameTrim(1) compositePart(1) | opEnclose for endcap; opCreate/ModifyCompositePart; frame = multi-path sweep system. |
| **Datum & parametrics** | cplane(3) helix(1) mateConnector(2) tag(1) variable(3) queryVariable(12) plane/axis/point/coordSystem (opPlane/opPoint/opSphere via geomOperations + coordSystem module) | The feature-tree "non-geometry" nodes. variable+queryVariable = Quantity/Query stored at document scope — the AI co-pilot's parameter surface. |
| **Sheet metal (16)** | sheetMetalStart(9) End Bend BendRelief Flange Formed InFlat Jog Joint Loft MakeJoint Tab Unfold Corner CornerBreak Attribute Utils(20) | Full workflow: start/activate → bends/flanges/jogs → form features → unfold to flat (`SMFlatOp` = extrude in flat view). `sheetMetalAttribute` (31 funcs) carries gauge/bend-table metadata. |
| **Interop & assembly hooks** | importDerived(4) importForeign(3) pcbStart(1) pcbEnd(10) routingCurve(11) annotation (featureList + defaultFeatures) | Derived parts across Part Studios; STEP/SKD import; flex-PCB; tubing; dimensions-as-features. |

## 4. GAP TABLE — Onshape capability vs cadjs today

cadjs status verified 2026-10-17 from `~/cadjs/src` exports (kernel: `extrudeBRep revolveBRep sweepBRep loftBReps filletBRep chamferBRep booleanOp/combineToBoolean`; sketch: planegcs + `addPrimitiveToSketch addConstraintToSketch`; topology picking: `collectSubShapes asEdge/asFace/asSolid/asShell/asWire`; history: `apply*ToTree buildUndoSnapshot`). ONSHAPE_MAP §3 is the feature→OCC-call cheat sheet; OCC class names below are the port targets.

| Onshape op*/feature | cadjs status | Port target (OCC / mechanism) |
|---|---|---|
| opExtrude, opRevolve, opSweep, opLoft | ✅ HAVE | `extrudeBRep revolveBRep sweepBRep loftBReps` — add Onshape enum parity: `sweeptwisttype`/`lofttopology` (ruled vs smooth, twists) |
| opFillet, opChamfer, opFullRoundFillet, opModifyFillet | ✅ HAVE (basic) | `filletBRep chamferBRep`; missing: conditional radii, per-vertex blend (BRepBlend), modify |
| opBoolean (+ cutlist, enclose) | ✅ HAVE join/cut/common | `booleanOp`; missing: common-only UI, enclose (`BRepAlgoAPI_Sewing`+`MakeSolid`) |
| opShell, opThicken | ❌ MISSING | `BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid` — phase 8 item already slated |
| opPattern (linear/circular/curve pattern, mirror, transformCopy) | ❌ MISSING | transform + repeat + fuse; mirror = opTransform(mirror matrix) + boolean; `gp_Trsf` mirror/rotation |
| opDraft, opBodyDraft | ❌ MISSING | `BRepOffsetAPI_DraftAngle` (+ parting-line edge collection via qAdjacent) |
| opMoveFace | ❌ MISSING | `BRepOffsetAPI_DraftAngle`/`MoveFace`; the VR direct-edit flagship (grip→face→push) |
| opDeleteFace, opReplaceFace, opExtendFace | ❌ MISSING | `ShapeFix`/heal after removal; extend via surface extrapolation (`GeomFill_Sweep`/`BRepOffsetAPI_ExtendFace`) |
| opMutualTrim, opSplitFace, opSplitPart, opIntersectFaces, opSplitEdges | ❌ MISSING | `BRepAlgoAPI_Splitter`, `ShapeSplit`, section curves (`BRepExtrema`/`IntTools`) |
| opBoundarySurface, opFillSurface, opRuledSurface, opConstrainedSurface, opCreateBSplineSurface, opExtractSurface (offset) | ❌ MISSING | `BRepOffsetAPI_ThruSections`, `BRepFill_Filling`, `GeomFill_BoundWithSurface`, `BRepOffsetAPI_MakeOffset` |
| opFitSpline, opSplineThroughEdges, opDropCurve, opMoveCurveBoundary, opOffsetCurveOnFace, opProjectCurve(s), opCreateCurvesOnFace | ❌ MISSING (wire-level) | `GeomAPI_Interpolate`, `BRepProj_Projection`, curve trim/extend `BRepBuilderAPI_MakeCurveOnSurface` |
| opWrap (decal/cylindrical wrap) | ❌ MISSING | `BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipe`-along-face projection workflow; wraptype enum = planar↔cylindrical↔cone mapping |
| opHole (all profile types) | ❌ MISSING | compound = boolean of drill cylinders + countersinks; enum `holeprofiletype` drives sketch-free generation |
| opCreateCompositePart, opModifyCompositePart, frame/rib/gusset/endcap | ❌ MISSING | sewing/packing; rib/gusset = profiled sweep+boolean; endcap = opEnclose |
| opMateConnector, opPlane/opPoint/opSphere/opPolyline/opHelix (datums) | ⚠️ partial (planes in sketch system) | datum entities as first-class tree nodes with ids — feeds historical queries |
| opMergeContexts (assembly/derived) | ❌ MISSING | multi-context import = `importDerived` equivalent (cadjs currently single-document) |
| Sketch entities + 34 ConstraintTypes + skSolve | ✅ HAVE 14 of 34 | cadjs `ConstraintType` union (verified, `src/types/sketch-types.ts`): coincident/horizontal/vertical/parallel/perpendicular/tangent/equal/concentric/pointOnLine/pointOnCircle/distance(±X/Y)/angle/radius/diameter. Missing parity: MIRROR MIDPOINT NORMAL FIX PROJECTED OFFSET PIERCE QUADRANT SILHOUETTED INTERSECTED RHO FREEZE EQUAL_CURVATURE(+_G3) BEZIER_DEGREE CENTERLINE_DIMENSION MAJOR/MINOR_DIAMETER LINEAR/CIRCULAR_PATTERN (see §2.5 full enum) |
| Query system (q* state + historical, deferred) | ❌ MISSING — only live pointer picks | THE central gap: persist selection as predicate JSON re-resolved per rebuild; T-tag stable topology ids (REA pass §5 checklist item targets exactly this mapping) |
| variables / configurations / featureStates | ⚠️ tree exists, no expression engine | Quantity `{expression,units,value}` evaluator + variable table re-driven each rebuild |
| Appearance / transparency / material | ⚠️ render-side only | Appearance params as tree data (feeds VR bridge #6, §5) |
| Sheet metal family (16 modules) | ❌ MISSING | lowest priority; `BRepOffsetAPI` unfold workflows only if engineering users demand |

**Structural verdict:** cadjs has the *body-building* third of Onshape (extrude/revolve/sweep/loft/fillet/chamfer/boolean + sketch/solve) but lacks the *deferred-query rebuild core* (pillar 3) and both *editing halves* (surface ops, direct edits, patterns, shell). The ladder below sequences exactly those.

## 5. THE SIX VR BRIDGES — owner's UX asks → Onshape mechanisms

| # | VR bridge (owner's words) | Onshape mechanism (this doc) | Implementation note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Sketches** | `newSketch` on a planar entity → `sk*` entities → 27 `ConstraintType`s → `skSolve`; sketch = a feature with entities+constraints payload (BTMSketch) | cadjs planegcs pipeline already shaped 1:1; VR trigger-point flow fills `skPoint/skLineSegment/skArc/skCircle`; plane pick via ray→face→`qCreatedBy` (Part 1 done). Gap: constraint *glyphs* in PiP = ConstraintType enum render map. |
| 2 | **Surfaces / faces** | `EntityType.FACE` + state queries (`qAdjacent`, `qAxis`, `qParallelPlanes`, `qEdgeConvexityTypeFilter`) + `ev*` face family | Face grab = resolve query → highlight sub-shape; every face op in §4 routes through a query, not a pointer. |
| 3 | **"Edges holding things"** | The Query model itself (pillar 3): edges/faces referenced by *criteria* survive edits; historical queries pin provenance (`qCreatedBy(id+"op", EDGE)`) | cadjs must store selection predicates in tree JSON → an edge "holding" a fillet re-finds its edge after upstream edits. This is the parametric durability the belt UX implies. |
| 4 | **Shrink-grow + relative scale** | `Quantity{expression,units,value}` re-evaluated per rebuild + `opTransform`/`transformCopy` (scaleNonuniformly, TransformType) | Two-hand pinch → writes an expression into the source dimension (relative scale = driven formula), not a baked matrix; tree rebuild does the scaling deterministically. |
| 5 | **Measurement** | `ev*` family (§2.3): evVolume, evMassProperties (mass/centroid/inertia), evArea, evLength, evDistance, evVertexNormal… + REST `massproperties` as oracle | Measure mode = pure `ev*` port; no kernel extension needed. Billboards in VR = same numbers Onshape reports → cross-checkable against real Onshape via API (handoff §4.1). |
| 6 | **Transparency** | Appearance parameters on features + `setFeatureHiddenParameters`/`suppressed` flag; material refs (BTMParameter.Appearance/Material) | Transparency as *tree data* per body/feature, not three.js material state — survives rebuild, exportable; `suppressed` = VR "ghost" toggle. |

## 6. PORT PRIORITY LADDER — tied to SCADGEN_BUILD_PHASES_16.md 7–10

Ordering logic: value-per-VR-interaction ÷ OCC port effort, respecting §4 dependencies (queries precede anything that re-resolves; pattern precedes rib/frame).

| Tier | Phase | Port (FS source → cadjs target) | Why here |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | 7 | **Query-as-data layer** (query.fs predicates → cadjs tree) + **shell/thicken** (opShell/opThicken → BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid) + **mirror/linear/circular pattern** (linearPattern/circularPattern/mirror → opTransform+opPattern) | Patterns+shell are the belt slots already UI'd (Fillet/Shell/…); queries are the prerequisite for every later feature's durability; phase 7's "live symmetry" IS mirror-as-feature. |
| **2** | 7–8 | **Variables/Quantity expressions** (variable.fs + units.fs expressions → tree evaluator) → then **draft** (opDraft) and **hole** (hole.fs/opHole: enum-driven drill, no sketch needed) | Expression engine unlocks bridge #4 (relative scale) and AI parameter edits; draft/hole are pure-kernel, UI-small, big "real CAD" optics. |
| **3** | 8 | **Direct edit trio**: opMoveFace, opDeleteFace(heal), opSplitPart/splitFace; then **modifyFillet + fillet enum parity** | This tier makes VR grabbing-geometry feel like SolidWorks-style direct editing on a BRep; phase 8 edge/fillet UX lands on top. |
| **4** | 8–9 | **Surface tier A**: opRuledSurface, opFillSurface, opExtractSurface(offset), opProjectCurves (ruledSurface/fillSurface/projectCurves/offsetSurface.fs) | Loft/sweep already exist; these four complete a usable surfacing vocabulary for the AI co-pilot's phase-9 geometry-code corpus (every op = a callable verb with typed params = training pair). |
| **5** | 9–10 | **Surface tier B**: opBoundarySurface, opConstrainedSurface, bsurf, bridgingCurve, fitSpline; **enclose/endcap**; rib/gusset | Organic shaping for printability-audit demos (phase 10's overhang labels read better on blended bodies); enclose is a one-call op. |
| **6** | 10+ | **wrap/decal, threads (externalThread), compositePart, mateConnector, datums-as-features (helix/cplane), importForeign** | Assembly/printing parity; mateConnector matters when scadgen does multi-body; wrap for labels-on-printables. |
| **7** | backlog | **Sheet metal family (16 modules), pcbStart/End, routingCurve, frame/frameTrim** | Real engineering domains, expensive ports; defer until owner's user base demands. |
